Car accident injures children waiting for school bus in Greater Noida

A woman learning to drive in Greater Noida accidentally accelerated instead of braking, hitting a group of children waiting for their school bus. Reports vary on the number of children injured, with figures ranging from three to seven. One child sustained serious injuries and was hospitalized. The incident occurred outside a society in Greater Noida. Police have taken the woman into custody.
